text: What is the primary objective of the National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (NREGA)?
options: To provide a minimum of 100 days of guaranteed wage employment to rural households
To promote organic farming in rural areas
To provide credit facilities to rural households
To promote self-help groups (SHGs) in rural areas
explanation: The National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (NREGA) aims to provide a minimum of 100 days of guaranteed wage employment to rural households, thereby ensuring a basic level of income security and social protection.
subject: Economics
chapter: Ch 9: Current Challenges Facing Indian Economy
